entities.name: Eesha
entities.description: Aven commander of the northern branch of the Order on Otaria.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: Military order on Otaria with northern and southern branches.

entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: Order leader who died suddenly during the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: Order leader who died during the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Teroh
entities.description: Aven leader whose crusade failed; died in the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Battle in which Pianna, Kirtar and Teroh died.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction with which Eesha negotiated a truce.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Manipulated Eesha with lies into helping capture Kamahl.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Wrongfully blamed by Eesha for the destruction of the Order's citadel.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where the Order is based.

events.summary: Eesha rises to full power over the Order after the deaths of Pianna, Kirtar and Teroh.
events.quote: Eesha came to full power over the whole Order following the sudden deaths of Pianna , Kirtar and Teroh during the Battle for the Mirari .

events.summary: Eesha is willing to negotiate a truce with the Cabal.
events.quote: she was willing to negotiate a truce with the Cabal .

events.summary: Laquatus manipulates Eesha into sending troops to capture Kamahl; she withdraws when the lies are revealed.
events.quote: she withdrew her troops when Laquatus' lies were revealed.

relations.quote: Eesha came to full power over the whole Order
